input_selection: explicit current sources from analysis_completion_20261002_v1; no directory-order selection
model: physiological feature ~ VAS + participant fixed effects + categorical 5-minute block
support: complete 5 observed numeric minutes per block; >=2 distinct blocks; no imputation
hb_scale: sample SD across eligible blocks within participant, inherited frozen model-input scale; not absolute concentration

inference.estimator: OLS with absorbed participant fixed effects
inference.variance: CR1 cluster sandwich; finite factor G/(G-1)*(N-1)/(N-G-K), K slope and nonredundant block columns
inference.sensitivity: delete-one-participant CRV3 jackknife variance and t(G-1); complete four-block subset; strictly adjacent first differences

wild_cluster.method: null-restricted Rademacher participant wild bootstrap-t; CR1 studentization each replicate

multiplicity.global_all_161: BY and BH, all estimates and nulls retained
multiplicity.wild: BY n=24 and conservative global n=161

joint: VAS ~ HR + candidate RR-RMSSD + one Hb feature + participant and block fixed effects, same rows; no predictive-gain claim
EGG_VAS: each of 3 frozen EGG descriptors ~ VAS + participant and block fixed effects
rest_challenge: mean of paired measured candidate differences; one approved E-source matched to baseline N per unique current participant; exclude source ambiguity before quality; paired t CI/test, jackknife/median descriptive sensitivity; record averages have unequal durations
timing_sensitivity: refit 24 targets for frozen A/B x offsets 0, +/-10, +/-30, +/-60 s and frozen drift +/-100 ppm; label nominal time uncertainty; no significance-based selection
Hb_QC_sensitivity: original mask MAD6 guard2s; compare coverage .90/.95 and ROI .50/.75; no parameter selection by effects
limitations: no independent normal-beat reference, accepted gastric rhythm reference or cortical source specificity; statistics refer to measured features and do not remove measurement error or confounding
preservation: source and historical outputs immutable; no sealed annotations accessed; no human expert validation claimed
public_configuration_note: Personal locations removed; configure a controlled analysis root and a new private run directory. Original scientific parameters are unchanged.
